led_box_pose_sdk vendor delivery
================================

This directory holds a binary-only delivery (header + static library)
of led_box_pose_sdk from the algorithm team. Source is not available;
do not attempt to build from here.

Files:
  include/led_box_pose_sdk.hpp        public C++ API (PImpl, POD-only)
  lib/aarch64/libled_box_pose_sdk.a   static library (RK3588 / aarch64)
  INTEGRATION.md                       upstream integration notes (reference)
  VERSION.txt                          this file

Vendored on : 2026-05-28
Source SHA  : (fill on next refresh; current copy lifted from
              external/led_box_pose_sdk/ at commit 29944e1)
Toolchain   : aarch64-buildroot-linux-gnu, GCC 11.4
Runtime deps: librknnrt.so (>= 2.3.x), libopencv_core, libopencv_imgproc

When refreshing this delivery, also bump assets/models/MODELS_VERSION.txt
if the .rknn files in the new package differ from those under assets/models/.
